title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Thread Between the Stars

lines.l: You were the thread between the stars
The silent pool beneath my tide
I keep the land I live for you
Where all our stories used to hide
You're not lost, it's just out of view
A truth that time can't quite undo
Photographs have blurred their meaning
But your voice still finds its way
I speak in riddles half revealing
Try and hold what slips away
If I could write you into mourning
Would you rise like mist again?
Or stay a song the night keeps singing
Soft as hope, sharp as pain
You were the thread between the stars
The silent pool beneath my tide
I keep the land I live for you
Where all our stories used to hide
You're not lost, just out of view
A truth that time can't quite undo
Still I sing those skies anew
And trace the thread that leads to you
